listen_address.description: IP address the worker HTTP server binds to (e.g., 127.0.0.1 for localhost-only, or 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

listen_port.description: Port number the worker HTTP server listens on.

control_socket_path.description: Absolute path to the Unix domain socket used for local health checks and control commands.

max_concurrent_work.description: Maximum number of work items the worker can process in parallel.

work_timeout.description: Maximum seconds allowed per work item before it is forcibly terminated.

server_url.description: HTTP(S) URL of the Debusine server to register with and pull work from.

registration_token.description: Secret token used to authenticate the worker with the server (should match server’s configured token).

labels.description: Optional key-value labels to attach to this worker (shown in the server dashboard for identification).

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting.

log_format.description: Format for log output: 'text' (human-readable) or 'json' (structured, machine-parsable).
